title: Cosmic Whisper
description: A surreal profile portrait of a woman's face emerging from swirling clouds and smoke. Her skin bears black calligraphic tattoos, with one eye open gazing forward while cosmic nebulae fill the night sky on the left and glowing orange concentric rings resembling galaxies or black holes dominate the right side.
prompt: surreal profile portrait of a woman with light brown skin, one visible eye looking forward, black calligraphic script tattoos running down her face and neck, white smoke flowing from her mouth, background split between starry purple nebula with Milky Way on the left and swirling orange glowing concentric galactic rings on the right, dark dramatic clouds below, mystical atmosphere, detailed oil painting style
